title: FUSION: a skill-based research agent for publicly obtainable nuclear-physics codes
abstract: arXiv:2609.04742v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Running an unfamiliar nuclear-physics code is rarely difficult because of the physics alone. One must find and build the program, learn its input conventions, and decide whether a plausible output is actually correct. A general-purpose coding agent helps with the first two tasks but may make the last one harder: it can write an input file that runs with the wrong physical convention. FUSION addresses this problem with code-specific skills. A skill obtains the code from its public source, starts from a verified input, runs and parses the calculation, records known failure modes, and must reproduce a stated benchmark to a stated tolerance before reporting a result. The current release covers twenty codes, spanning optical models and reactions, nuclear structure, fission and statistical models, astrophysics and R-matrix analysis, and heavy-ion transport. translated_title: FUSION：一个面向公开可获取核物理代码的基于技能的研究智能体
translated_abstract: 运行一个不熟悉的核物理代码，其困难很少仅仅源于物理本身。使用者必须找到并构建该程序、学习其输入约定，并判断一个看似合理的输出是否真的正确。通用编码智能体可以帮助完成前两项任务，但可能会使最后一项变得更难：它可能写出一个以错误物理约定成功运行的输入文件。FUSION 通过代码专用技能来解决这一问题。一个技能会从公开来源获取代码、从一个经过验证的输入出发、运行并解析计算、记录已知的失败模式，并且必须以规定的容差复现声明的基准测试后才能报告结果。当前发布版本涵盖二十个代码，涉及光学模型与核反应、核结构、裂变与统计模型、天体物理与 R 矩阵分析，以及重离子输运。此外，它还包括一个可离线检索的文档集合，收录了由……（摘要在此处被截断）派生的 61,167 页内容。
tldr: FUSION 是一个基于代码专用技能的核物理研究智能体，通过获取公开代码、从经验证的输入出发运行计算，并要求在报告结果前以规定容差复现基准测试，从而解决通用智能体可能产生错误物理约定结果的问题。
en_tdlr: FUSION is a skill-based research agent for publicly available nuclear-physics codes that addresses the risk of plausible but physically incorrect outputs by requiring each code-specific skill to reproduce a stated benchmark within a stated tolerance before reporting results.
